description: Source code for a Zephyr driver managing an ExplorIR-M sensor via UART, including initialization, data fetching, buffer handling, and communication protocols.

methods.name: explorir_m_uart_flush
methods.description: Flushes UART FIFO buffer by reading all available data.

methods.name: explorir_m_uart_flush_until_end
methods.description: Flushes UART buffer until end character or timeout.

methods.name: explorir_m_buffer_reset
methods.description: Resets the read buffer and index.

methods.name: explorir_m_buffer_verify
methods.description: Verifies the buffer content and format for a specific type.

methods.name: explorir_m_buffer_process
methods.description: Processes the buffer data into sensor values based on type.

methods.name: explorir_m_uart_isr
methods.description: UART interrupt service routine for receiving data.

methods.name: explorir_m_await_receive
methods.description: Waits for UART response with timeout.

methods.name: explorir_m_uart_transceive
methods.description: Sends command over UART and processes response.

methods.name: explorir_m_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attribute, e.g., filter setting.

methods.name: explorir_m_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attribute, e.g., filter setting.

methods.name: explorir_m_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for a specific channel.

methods.name: explorir_m_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device and UART communication.
